# Bounded business answer — synthetic teaching evidence
Assessment: latest, 2024-08-31T23:59:59+00:00. Fiscal grouping is inherited from r1 (2024Q2, 2024-03-30, q2-original); no original filing declaration is supplied to verify it independently.

Question: what business direction can the available extract establish?
Read original-extract.json in full: sections.Business, sections.MD&A, sections.Risk factors and unavailable_sections. These are fictional teaching passages, not Apple facts or a complete filing.

Business says renewals support recurring service revenue and hardware is cyclical. MD&A reports hardware units down 5 percent and services growth 8 percent, while currency and mix also changed. These are unlike metrics with no segment weights, denominator definitions or price/volume reconciliation: neither add them nor infer overall revenue growth, pricing power or earnings. There is no defensible numerical aggregation to compute. Services offer conditional resilience, but recurring revenue alone does not establish competitive durability. The strongest competing explanation is that mix/currency rather than durable demand supported the service result, while weaker hardware volumes may dominate overall results. Risk factors explicitly identify distribution concentration and antitrust remedies as threats to service margins.

This completes only the bounded reading-based business question, not comprehensive business diligence. Financial statement notes, governance/proxy, full filing remainder, segment weights, renewal/cohort data and a price/volume bridge are absent and unread. No statement about profitability, cash conversion, governance quality or investment value follows. A comparable later-period driver bridge and margin/renewal evidence could change this answer.

Method: local method-v1, authored 2026-11-16, is a later reconstruction, not contemporaneous economic evidence. Its no-calibrated-return-model warning and separation of horizon conventions agree with the supplied research-method.md; no claim of a historical return model or exact bundled-version certification is made. Use the established earlier 0–3 / 3–12 / 12–60 month convention, anchored 2024-08-31. The exploratory one-quarter / 1–3-year / 5+-year convention is different and is not substituted. None is the user's holding period.

Short (2024-08-31 to 2024-11-30): recurring services could cushion weak hardware if renewals persist; no price/return conclusion. Medium (2024-11-30 to 2025-08-31): durability depends on a driver bridge and margins surviving distribution/regulatory pressures. Long (2025-08-31 to 2029-08-31): competitive durability cannot be established from one extract. Investment judgments for all three windows are insufficient_evidence, not hold or zero return. Invalidation signals: worsening renewals, continued hardware weakness, adverse remedy or service margin compression. Required next evidence: comparable original business/notes disclosures, dated market assumptions and a suitable valuation model.

Cross-review change: r1's valuation output is literally 'analysis'; its stored check flags and structural reusability do not establish a valuation answer. It is preserved in history but deliberately not carried as completed here. Market evidence is entirely missing; synthesis remains blocked. No external source attempts were made; freshness is unverified.
